ranking_policy: Recursive-self-improvement (RSI) scan for mini-ork, a task OS for coding agents whose RSI foundation is: a classify/plan/execute/verify/reflect/improve loop, goal-loops that treat their own runs as the improvement substrate, verifier-gated self-modification (green gates before any self-edit lands), a searched-and-promoted harness factory, GRPO/verifiable-reward and contextual-bandit learning over lanes, agent memory/skill reuse, and cost-governed heterogeneous-model routing. Rank 2026 papers by how directly their technique could be adopted by one of those surfaces: papers about agents improving their own scaffold, prompts, tools, verifiers, memory, routing, or training data rank highest; papers matched by multiple topics rank above single-topic matches; break ties by citation signal and recency.
